body.name: G_{\mathrm{ABC}}
body.def: For \(H=L=1\) and labels \(\{A,B,C\}\), \(G_{\mathrm{ABC}}\) has the sole directed edge \(A_{-1}\to C_0\), the sole bidirected edges \(A_0\leftrightarrow B_0\) and \(B_0\leftrightarrow C_0\), and no other edge.
body.role: Smallest prescribed overlapping-edge-latent stress test with one positive-lag arrow into \(C\).
